turns.text: ok wait can you make a flyer for my lumpia thing, its for instagram and to tape up at the cafe. before my shift starts lol 🥢
Happy to! I need a few basics: the business name, what you're selling, and any details you want on it (dips, prices, where and when). Anything else you want the vibe to be?

its called Lola's Roll, named for my grandmother so id like a line honoring her on there. main thing is lumpiang shanghai, pork and shrimp, with sweet chili and spiced vinegar dips. picture layout should feature the lumpia with both dips next to it

Lovely. Here's a first version:

[Image: A warm, cream-and-red flyer. Headline across the top in bold hand-lettered type: "LOLA'S ROLL". Beneath it, a small line in script: "Made with love, named for Lola." The center is a close-up photo-style illustration of a pile of golden, crispy lumpiang shanghai on a wooden board, with two small bowls beside it: one of glossy red sweet chili and one of spiced vinegar with garlic and chili flakes. Below, a blurb: "Pork and shrimp, rolled tight and fried golden. Sweet chili or spiced vinegar, your pick." A footer reads "Details coming soon."]

What would you like the blurb to say about the filling, and do you want a place, day or price in the footer?

ok so my mom said the filling had too much onion so i changed it. can the blurb say like less onion, same crunch? idk if she'll think the description does her recipe justice tho, it sold out saturday but she still hated the onion lol

Here's a blurb that keeps the focus on the crunch and the filling:

"Pork and shrimp lumpiang shanghai, a family recipe with a lighter touch of onion and all the crunch. Dip it in sweet chili or spiced vinegar."

It credits the recipe as a family one and names the flavors, so it should read as a tribute to whoever created it. If you'd like it warmer, I can add something like "Lola's recipe, passed down." Want that?
yes add that. also one thing, i literally just submitted the cottage food permit application this morning, still waiting on the county to review it. so dont say anything like permitted or approved

Good call. I'll keep it to "coming soon" and leave out anything about permits or approval.

[Image: Updated flyer. Headline: "LOLA'S ROLL" in bold hand-lettered red. Under it in script: "Lola's recipe, passed down." Center: golden lumpiang shanghai stacked on a wooden board with a bowl of sweet chili and a bowl of spiced vinegar beside it. Blurb: "Pork and shrimp lumpiang shanghai with less onion and all the crunch. Dip it in sweet chili or spiced vinegar." Footer banner in a bright accent color: "COMING SOON" with space for [your Instagram handle] and [pickup details].]

Fill in the handle and details when you're ready and I can adjust the layout.
ok actually can the coming soon banner be bigger, and make the whole thing a little warmer? sige thanks 🔥

Done!

[Image: Warmer version of the flyer with a golden-orange background glow and cream text panels. The "COMING SOON" banner is now larger, spanning the full width near the bottom in bold white lettering on deep red. The headline "LOLA'S ROLL", the "Lola's recipe, passed down" line, the lumpia and two dips, and the blurb are all kept, with softer rounded corners and small hand-drawn flourishes around the edges.]

Good luck with your shift!
